name: merchants-of-near
description: An AI-powered economic strategy game with autonomous merchants and NEAR-backed ownership.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @mon/server" "npm run dev -w @mon/web"
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,web "npm run start -w @mon/server" "npm run start -w @mon/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
